capabilities: Define rules that match notes by folder, tag, property, or Dataview query
Render virtual markdown as footer, header, sidebar panel, or within heading sections
Source virtual content from plugin settings or a note in the vault
Toggle rules on and off from the settings
Group sidebar content into shared or separate tabs
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not insert or save content into files; it only renders text virtually at set positions in matching notes.
extras: README documents limitations: links in virtual content need a workaround in Live Preview (right-click unsupported), and sectional content only works in Reading mode. Plugin was previously named 'Virtual Footer'.
problem: Repeating the same markdown or Dataview block in many notes bloats files and makes shared content hard to update in one place.

relations.evidence: Works with Dataview, Datacore and native Obisidan Bases
Works with Dataview, Datacore and native Obisidan Bases

summary: Rule-based renderer that displays markdown text (including Dataview queries or Bases) at the top, bottom, or sidebar of matching notes without modifying them.
